caption: The drawing depicts a round, shallow box with a lid rendered in shades of beige and light brown with blue decorative accents. The lid of the box features a blue border made of small circular dots, enclosing what appears to be an elongated blue pattern or motif in the center. The sides of the box are embellished with four horizontal rows of evenly spaced blue dots running parallel to the base, and between the second and third rows of dots, the name "LUMAN RAMSDELL" is written in capital letters. The drawing is centered within a lightly sketched rectangular frame on an off-white or faintly yellowed background.
title: Inkwell
